results.name: ACP initialization
results.detail: Kiro CLI 2.21.1; both engines negotiate ACP 1; v3 advertises message-addressed Fork.

results.name: Streaming and cross-process identity
results.detail: Native user message identity survives a new ACP process; context is retained.

results.name: Edit, Diff and two-stage approval
results.detail: Successful terminal Diff matches the actual file; consent and final review are separate.

results.name: Denial and Autopilot boundary
results.detail: Autopilot on still requested filesystem consent; denial prevented the edit.

results.name: Cancel and continuation
results.detail: Cancellation while waiting for approval returns cancelled; a later process can continue.

results.name: Question answer and cancellation
results.detail: Spec-mode Question works with advertised client capabilities; ordinary-mode probe did not trigger it.

results.name: Exact Fork, source isolation and continued write
results.detail: One source Turn was retained before the child's continuation; configuration was explicitly restored.

results.name: Compaction and historical identities
results.detail: Native summarization completed; reload retained both historical user identities.

results.name: Empty-prefix Fork remains writable
results.detail: A native bootstrap boundary produced zero user Turns before a successful new Turn.

results.name: Cross-cwd Fork and environment propagation
results.detail: The native shell reported the destination cwd and this run's harmless environment marker.

results.name: Native subagent observation
results.detail: A real native subtask has a stable observed ID and a successful result; transcript reads were not tested.

results.name: Configuration and account usage distinctions
results.detail: Effort write returned without a confirmed effective value; native account usage and session listing work.

results.name: Negative protocol findings
results.detail: Rejected v3 flags, broken help, invalid checkpoint rejection, and non-rollback rewind response are preserved.
